budget.name: per-step time-to-action
budget.rule: each tool call finishes within 10 s
budget.replaces: The prior amendment counted a trajectory only when every local turn wall was at or below 10 s. P1 uses per-step time-to-action instead.

baseline_recount.grain: The ledger stores one t_generate per turn, the time until that turn's tool calls exist. A turn can hold more than one decoded call and has no per-call clock. At that grain the rule is: every local turn on the trajectory has t_generate at or below 10 s.
baseline_recount.why_the_count_matches: The seven local_pass trajectories excluded by the turn-wall rule also have a t_generate above 10 s. Changing the clock from turn wall to t_generate does not move the baseline. The other arm predictions on the prior amendment were built from this same 14 and stay on that file.
